name: still-water
description: Still Water: a short procedural pixel-art fishing horror game in a single HTML file

scripts.build:site: node build.js --out=site/index.html && node build.js --test --out=site/test.html && node build.js --lang=ru --out=site/ru/index.html && node build.js --lang=ru --test --out=site/ru/test.html
scripts.domtest: node build.js && node build.js --lang=ru && node tools/domtest.js
